$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: qc_composition
title: qc.composition.tsv
description: Amino acid composition of identified peptides against the composition the search database predicts for the same proteins: one row per file and residue, then the same residues for a `total` row covering the run. Interior residues only. Headline numbers are in run-summary.json under qc.composition.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Spectrum file name, or `total` for the rows covering all files.

fields.name: residue
fields.description: One-letter amino acid code, uppercase. A row is present when the residue was counted in either profile, so the residues present vary with the data.

fields.name: observed
fields.description: Interior residues of this kind in the distinct confident target peptide sequences of this file.

fields.name: observed_fraction
fields.description: `observed` divided by all interior residues observed in this file, six decimals.

fields.name: expected
fields.description: Interior residues of this kind in the distinct database peptide sequences of the proteins identified in this file.

fields.name: expected_fraction
fields.description: `expected` divided by all interior residues expected for this file, six decimals.

fields.name: log2_ratio
fields.description: `log2(observed_fraction / expected_fraction)`, four decimals. Empty when either fraction is zero, where the ratio has no finite value. Negative means the residue is seen less often than the database predicts.
